description: This source file defines an internal class SQSStorage that acts as a helper/wrapper for interacting with AWS SQS queues, including operations such as initializing the queue, adding messages, retrieving messages, and deleting messages. It manages AWS credentials, creates the SQS client, and provides logging for errors.

classes.name: SQSStorage
classes.description: Internal helper class for managing AWS SQS queue interactions, including queue creation, message sending, receiving, and deletion.

methods.name: SQSStorage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SQSStorage instance with logger, queue name, connection string, and optional service ID.

methods.name: ParseDataConnectionString
methods.description: Parses the connection string to extract AWS credentials and service URL.

methods.name: CreateClient
methods.description: Creates the AmazonSQSClient based on the parsed connection details, supporting local testing, explicit AWS credentials, or IAM Roles.

methods.name: GetQueueUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the URL for the configured SQS queue asynchronously.

methods.name: InitQueueAsync
methods.description: Initializes the queue by creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: AddMessage
methods.description: Adds a message to the SQS queue.

methods.name: GetMessages
methods.description: Retrieves messages from the queue, with a maximum of 10 messages.

methods.name: DeleteMessage
methods.description: Deletes a specified message from the queue.

methods.name: ReportErrorAndRethrow
methods.description: Logs errors and throws an AggregateException.

methods.name: LogErrorSQSOperation
methods.description: Partial method for logging SQS operation errors.
